rationale: C13 is a nearly verbatim predecessor: it uses the same one-sentence designation machinery for an Associate Justice of Puerto Rico's Supreme Court to act as the federal district judge, including authority to sign necessary papers, service without extra compensation, the same disability conditions, and a calendar-year limit. The child principally substitutes A. Cecil Snyder for Luis Negron-Fernandez and updates 1949 to 1950. C09 and C21 also concern temporary performance of an absent or disabled officer's duties, but their succession-list structure and wording are materially less similar.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I hereby designate and authorize the Honorable A. Cecil Snyder, Associate Justice of the Supreme Court of Puerto Rico, to perform and discharge the duties of Judge of the United States District Court for the District of Puerto Rico
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I hereby designate and authorize the Honorable Luis Negron-Fernandez, Associate Justice of the Supreme Court of Puerto Rico, to perform and discharge the duties of Judge of the District Court of the United States for Puerto Rico
shared_material.explanation: Nearly identical designation and authorization language, with only the appointee and minor court-name word order changed.

shared_material.child_excerpt: and to sign all necessary papers and records as Acting Judge of the said Court, without extra compensation
shared_material.parent_excerpt: and to sign all necessary papers and records as Acting Judge of the said Court, without extra compensation
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive operative language is reproduced verbatim.

shared_material.child_excerpt: during the absence, illness, or other legal disability of the Judge thereof, during the year 1950
shared_material.parent_excerpt: during the absence, illness, or other legal disability of the Judge thereof, during the year 1949
shared_material.explanation: The same triggering conditions and annual duration are retained, with the year advanced from 1949 to 1950.
